comparison.title: Totals comparison
comparison.hint: Each metric compares our line-item total against the carrier figure on the same basis; a positive difference means the bill states more than the lines add up to.
comparison.reportedConverted: Bill value, already converted with its embedded rate
comparison.notFolded: The bill has no embedded rate, so this stays unconverted
comparison.negativePayableNote: The bill states {value} on its payable row; the subtotal row is used for comparison.
comparison.supportHint: Summed from the bill line items; the bill provides no matching subtotal, so these only show whether its own subtotal agrees with its lines.
comparison.noFindings: Line-by-line recomputation matches the bill ({count} lines)

settle.title: Reconciliation info
settle.description: Choose the rate for this row. It only affects settlement and payment-flow amounts, not the row status.
settle.billRateSource: Embedded in bill · frozen on import
settle.rateMissingNote: Neither rate is available, so this row cannot be settled yet.
settle.paymentFeeFormula: Sales amount ÷ settlement rate × fee rate
settle.missingAmountAsZero: Amounts this row does not involve are counted as 0.
settle.paymentFeeOncePerSalesOrder: The payment fee is charged once per sales order: other lines of the same order do not add it again.
settle.errorUnchanged: The same settlement result already exists; nothing was recorded.
settle.errorRateChanged: The rate for this source has changed. Reopen the settlement dialog.
settle.errorMismatch: Amounts differ from the server recalculation. Reopen the settlement dialog.
settle.errorRateUnavailable: No rate is available for this source right now.
settle.errorSourceMissing: This row has no purchase or sales source, so it cannot be settled yet.
settle.errorKeyReused: This submission key was already used. Refresh and try again.
settle.errorBatchCompleted: This batch is already finished and cannot be settled again.
settle.errorStateChanged: Data changed or is being processed. Refresh and try again.
